White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt Resigns, Successor Speculated

White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt has announced her resignation. Donald Trump confirmed the departure. The role requires managing media relations and meeting Trump's expectations. Leavitt's tenure was marked by a combative relationship with the press. Potential successors are being discussed, though no official announcement has been made regarding her replacement. Leavitt stated her decision was "bittersweet" and she intends to spend time with her family.
